constituentArticles.title: Blackstone gets RBI approval for 9.99% stake purchase in Federal Bank
constituentArticles.text: RBI approved Blackstone affiliate Asia II Topco XIII to invest ₹6,196.51 crore for up to 9.99% stake in Federal Bank.
